<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="tr">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>Kasa — Metin2 Şifre Deposu</title>
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cinzel:wght@600;800&family=Sorts+Mill+Goudy&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;600&display=swap');

  :root{
    --bg: #04121c;
    --bg-panel: #0b2436;
    --bronze: #5fd0dd;
    --gold: #eaf9ff;
    --iron: #2a4a5c;
    --text: #eaf6ff;
    --text-dim: #9fc4d6;
    --danger: #d4514f;
    --line: #1d3a4a;
  }

  *{box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0;}

  @keyframes drift{
    0%{ transform: translateY(0) translateX(0); opacity:0; }
    10%{ opacity: 1; }
    90%{ opacity: 1; }
    100%{ transform: translateY(-620px) translateX(var(--dx)); opacity:0; }
  }
  .ember{
    position: fixed; bottom:-20px; width:4px; height:4px; border-radius:50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle, #ffffff 0%, #d8f4ff 45%, transparent 75%);
    box-shadow: 0 0 8px 2px rgba(170,230,255,0.6);
    pointer-events:none; animation: drift linear infinite; z-index:0;
  }

  #bgVideo{
    position: fixed; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%;
    object-fit: cover; z-index:-2;
    filter: brightness(0.55) saturate(1.15) contrast(1.05);
  }
  .ice-overlay{
    position: fixed; inset:0; z-index:-1; pointer-events:none;
    background:
      linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(2,10,18,0.55) 0%, rgba(4,24,36,0.2) 35%, rgba(4,24,36,0.2) 65%, rgba(2,10,18,0.6) 100%),
      linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(95,208,221,0.08), rgba(234,249,255,0.05));
  }

  body{
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--text);
    font-family: 'Sorts Mill Goudy', serif;
    min-height:100vh;
    padding: 48px 20px;
    overflow-x:hidden;
    position:relative;
  }

  .wrap{
    max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; position:relative; z-index:1;
    background: rgba(6,22,34,0.5);
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(1.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(95,208,221,0.35);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.35), 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.55), 0 0 80px rgba(95,208,221,0.15), inset 0 0 60px rgba(234,249,255,0.04);
    padding: 56px 52px 46px;
  }

  @keyframes fadeUp{ from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(14px);} to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0);} }

  header{ text-align:center; margin-bottom: 36px; animation: fadeUp 0.7s ease both; }

  @keyframes pulseGlow{ 0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(255,255,255,0.25);} 50%{box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(255,255,255,0.6);} }
  @keyframes spinSlow{ from{transform:rotate(45deg);} to{transform:rotate(405deg);} }

  .sigil{
    width:74px; height:74px; margin:0 auto 22px;
    border: 2px solid var(--gold);
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    animation: spinSlow 14s linear infinite, pulseGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .sigil::after{ content:''; width:30px; height:30px; border:2px solid var(--bronze); transform: rotate(45deg); }

  h1{
    font-family:'Cinzel', serif; font-weight:800; font-size: 3.2rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    color: var(--gold); text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(234,249,255,0.35);
  }
  .subtitle{ color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 1.3rem; margin-top: 12px; font-style: italic; }
  .divider{ width:160px; height:1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--bronze), transparent); margin: 32px auto 0; }

  .status{
    text-align:center; font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size:0.85rem;
    color: var(--text-dim); margin-top:14px; min-height: 16px; letter-spacing:0.04em;
  }
  .status.ok{ color: var(--gold); }

  .toolbar{ display:flex; gap:12px; margin-bottom: 22px; flex-wrap:wrap; animation: fadeUp 0.7s ease 0.1s both; }

  .map-section{ margin-bottom: 26px; animation: fadeUp 0.7s ease 0.05s both; }
  .map-wrap{
    position: relative; width: 100%; max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 10px 0;
  }
  .map-img{ display:block; width:100%; height:auto; opacity: 0.97; filter: drop-shadow(0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.65)); }
  .map-flag{
    position: absolute; width: 35px; height: 24px; border-radius: 4px;
    border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5); background: rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
    cursor: pointer; transform: translate(-50%,-50%);
    transition: box-shadow 0.25s, transform 0.2s, border-color 0.25s;
  }
  .map-flag:hover{ transform: translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.15); }
  .flag-yellow{ left: 21%; top: 30%; box-shadow: 0 0 10px 2px rgba(217,164,65,0.5); }
  .flag-yellow:hover{ border-color: #d9a441; box-shadow: 0 0 18px 6px rgba(217,164,65,0.75); }
  .flag-blue{ left: 83%; top: 51%; box-shadow: 0 0 10px 2px rgba(45,212,191,0.5); }
  .flag-blue:hover{ border-color: #2dd4bf; box-shadow: 0 0 18px 6px rgba(45,212,191,0.75); }
  .flag-red{ left: 56%; top: 82%; box-shadow: 0 0 10px 2px rgba(239,68,68,0.5); }
  .flag-red:hover{ border-color: #ef4444; box-shadow: 0 0 18px 6px rgba(239,68,68,0.75); }
  .map-hint{ text-align:center; margin-top: 8px; font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-dim); }
  .search{
    flex:1; min-width:200px; background: rgba(28,22,16,0.7); border:1px solid var(--line); color: var(--text);
    padding: 12px 16px; font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size:0.9rem; outline:none;
    transition: border-color 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s;
  }
  .search::placeholder{ color: var(--text-dim); }
  .search:focus{ border-color: var(--gold); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(234,249,255,0.14), 0 0 16px rgba(95,208,221,0.25); }

  .btn{
    background: var(--gold); color:#04121c; border:none; padding: 12px 22px;
    font-family:'Cinzel', serif; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.05em; font-size:0.85rem; cursor:pointer;
    transition: filter 0.2s, transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.2s;
  }
  .btn:hover{ filter: brightness(1.15); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(95,208,221,0.4); }
  .btn:active{ transform: translateY(0); }
  .btn:focus-visible{ outline: 2px solid var(--text); outline-offset:2px; }
  .btn.ghost{
    background: transparent; color: var(--text-dim); border: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .btn.ghost:hover{ color: var(--text); border-color: var(--bronze); box-shadow:none; }

  .empty{
    text-align:center; padding: 50px 20px; color: var(--text-dim);
    border: 1px dashed var(--line); font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.85rem;
    animation: fadeUp 0.6s ease both;
    transition: border-color 0.3s;
  }
  .empty:hover{ border-color: var(--bronze); }
  .empty-chars{ display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:flex-end; gap: 24px; margin-bottom: 18px; }

  .kingdom-banner{
    display:none; position:relative; overflow:hidden;
    border: 1px solid var(--line); margin-bottom: 16px; padding: 16px 20px;
    align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap: 16px;
    animation: fadeUp 0.4s ease both;
  }
  .kingdom-banner.show{ display:flex; }
  .kingdom-banner .kb-title{ font-family:'Cinzel', serif; font-weight:700; font-size:1rem; letter-spacing:0.04em; z-index:1; }
  .kingdom-banner .kb-close{
    background:none; border:1px solid var(--iron); color: var(--text-dim); cursor:pointer;
    padding: 5px 11px; font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size:0.68rem; z-index:1;
  }
  .kingdom-banner .kb-close:hover{ color: var(--text); border-color: var(--bronze); }
  .kingdom-banner .kb-chars{
    position:absolute; right: 10px; bottom:-10px; display:flex; gap: 4px; opacity: 0.35; pointer-events:none;
  }
  .kingdom-banner .kb-chars img{ height: 90px; width:auto; object-fit:contain; }
  .kingdom-banner.yellow{ background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(217,164,65,0.16), rgba(28,22,16,0.7)); border-color: rgba(217,164,65,0.4); }
  .kingdom-banner.blue{ background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(45,212,191,0.16), rgba(28,22,16,0.7)); border-color: rgba(45,212,191,0.4); }
  .kingdom-banner.red{ background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(239,68,68,0.16), rgba(28,22,16,0.7)); border-color: rgba(239,68,68,0.4); }
  .empty-char-img{ height: 120px; width:auto; object-fit:contain; filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)); opacity:0.92; }
  .empty-text{ font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size:0.85rem; color: var(--text-dim); }

  .entries{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:16px; }

  @keyframes glowPulse{
    0%,100%{ box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--kdim, rgba(95,208,221,0.15)); }
    50%{ box-shadow: 0 0 22px var(--kdim, rgba(95,208,221,0.35)); }
  }
  @keyframes cardShimmer{
    0%{ transform: translateX(-120%); }
    100%{ transform: translateX(220%); }
  }
  @keyframes charFloat{
    0%,100%{ transform: translateY(0); }
    50%{ transform: translateY(-4px); }
  }
  @keyframes cornerPulse{ 0%,100%{ opacity:0.55; } 50%{ opacity:1; } }
  @keyframes sparkBurst{
    0%{ opacity:0; transform: translate(0,0) scale(0.4); }
    25%{ opacity:1; }
    100%{ opacity:0; transform: translate(var(--sx), var(--sy)) scale(1); }
  }

  .entry-corner{
    position:absolute; width:12px; height:12px; z-index:2; pointer-events:none;
    border: 2px solid var(--k, var(--gold)); opacity:0.75;
    animation: cornerPulse 2.6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .entry-corner.tl{ top:4px; left:4px; border-right:none; border-bottom:none; }
  .entry-corner.bl{ bottom:4px; left:4px; border-right:none; border-top:none; }

  .entry-spark{
    position:absolute; width:3px; height:3px; border-radius:50%; z-index:3; pointer-events:none;
    background: var(--k, var(--gold)); box-shadow: 0 0 6px 1px var(--k, var(--gold));
    animation: sparkBurst 0.7s ease-out forwards;
  }

  .entry{
    position:relative; overflow:hidden;
    border-left: 2px solid var(--k, var(--bronze));
    background: linear-gradient(100deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--k, var(--bronze)) 10%, transparent), rgba(28,22,16,0.75) 55%);
    padding: 16px 118px 16px 20px;
    animation: fadeUp 0.5s ease both, glowPulse 4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .entry::after{
    content:''; position:absolute; top:0; left:0; width:38%; height:100%;
    background: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent, color-mix(in srgb, var(--k, var(--bronze)) 20%, transparent), transparent);
    animation: cardShimmer 6s ease-in-out infinite; pointer-events:none;
  }
  .entry-char{
    position:absolute; right:4px; bottom:0; top:26px; z-index:1;
    height:calc(100% - 26px); width:100px; max-width:32%;
    object-fit:cover; object-position: top center;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px var(--kdim, rgba(95,208,221,0.4)));
    animation: charFloat 3.6s ease-in-out infinite;
    pointer-events:none;
    -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to top, transparent 0%, black 20%, black 80%, transparent 100%);
    mask-image: linear-gradient(to top, transparent 0%, black 20%, black 80%, transparent 100%);
    opacity: 0.85;
  }

  .entry-name{ font-family:'Cinzel', serif; font-weight:600; font-size: 1.02rem; color: var(--text); position:relative; z-index:2; }
  .entry-tag{
    position:absolute; top:0; right:0; z-index:2;
    font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size:0.62rem; font-weight:600; color:#04241f;
    background: var(--k, var(--gold));
    padding: 3px 9px; letter-spacing:0.05em; white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .entry-meta{ display:flex; gap:22px; flex-wrap:wrap; font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size:0.8rem; color: var(--text-dim); margin-top:12px; position:relative; z-index:2; }
  .entry-meta span b{ color: var(--text); font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.04em; }

  .entry-toprow{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; position:relative; z-index:2; margin-top:12px; }
  .entry-creds{ display:flex; gap:10px; flex:1; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .entry-chip{
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--k, var(--bronze)) 8%, transparent), rgba(255,255,255,0.02));
    border:1px solid var(--iron); padding:6px 12px;
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
    transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
  }
  .entry-chip:hover{ border-color: var(--k, var(--bronze)); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--kdim, rgba(95,208,221,0.25)); }
  .entry-chip .ic{ font-size:0.85rem; color: var(--k, var(--bronze)); opacity:0.9; flex-shrink:0; }
  .entry-chip .txt{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px; }
  .entry-chip .lbl{ font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size:0.56rem; color: var(--text-dim); letter-spacing:0.1em; text-transform:uppercase; }
  .entry-chip .val{ font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size:0.8rem; color: var(--text); font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.02em; }
  .entry-chip .val.dots{ letter-spacing:0.2em; color: var(--text-dim); }

  .entry-gear{
    width:32px; height:32px; flex-shrink:0; background:rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border:1px solid var(--iron);
    color: var(--text-dim); font-size:0.9rem; cursor:pointer; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
  }
  .entry-gear:hover, .entry-gear.active{ color: var(--k, var(--gold)); border-color: var(--k, var(--gold)); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--kdim, rgba(234,249,255,0.3)); transform:rotate(45deg); }

  @keyframes actionsGlowLine{
    0%{ background-position: -100% 0; }
    100%{ background-position: 200% 0; }
  }
  @keyframes actionsFadeIn{
    0%{ opacity:0; transform: translateY(-4px); }
    100%{ opacity:1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }

  .entry-actions{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap:8px; position:relative; z-index:2;
    max-height:0; opacity:0; overflow:hidden; margin-top:0; padding-top:0;
    transition: max-height 0.32s ease, opacity 0.25s ease, margin-top 0.32s ease, padding-top 0.32s ease;
  }
  .entry-actions::before{
    content:''; position:absolute; top:0; left:0; right:0; height:1px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--k, var(--gold)), transparent);
    background-size: 200% 100%;
    opacity:0;
  }
  .entry-actions.open{
    max-height:200px; opacity:1; margin-top:14px; padding-top:12px;
  }
  .entry-actions.open::before{
    opacity:1; animation: actionsGlowLine 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .entry-actions.open button{ animation: actionsFadeIn 0.35s ease both; }
  .entry-actions.open button:nth-child(1){ animation-delay: 0.02s; }
  .entry-actions.open button:nth-child(2){ animation-delay: 0.07s; }
  .entry-actions.open button:nth-child(3){ animation-delay: 0.12s; }
  .entry-actions.open button:nth-child(4){ animation-delay: 0.17s; }
  .entry-actions button{
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
    border: 1px solid var(--iron);
    color: var(--text-dim);
    font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size:0.68rem; letter-spacing:0.04em; text-transform:uppercase;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    cursor:pointer;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
  }
  .entry-actions button svg{ width:13px; height:13px; stroke: currentColor; fill:none; stroke-width:1.8; flex-shrink:0; }
  .entry-actions button.toggle:hover{ color:var(--k, var(--gold)); border-color:var(--k, var(--gold)); box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--kdim, rgba(234,249,255,0.25)); transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .entry-actions button.copy:hover{ color:var(--k, var(--bronze)); border-color:var(--k, var(--bronze)); box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--kdim, rgba(95,208,221,0.25)); transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .entry-actions button.edit:hover{ color:#c9b8e0; border-color:#8a7aa8; box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(138,122,168,0.2); transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .entry-actions button.del:hover{ color:var(--danger); border-color:var(--danger); box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(176,67,46,0.25); transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .entry-actions button.copy.copied{ color:#8fbf7a; border-color:#8fbf7a; }
  @keyframes pop{ 0%{transform:scale(1);} 50%{transform:scale(1.15);} 100%{transform:scale(1);} }
  .entry-actions button.pop{ animation: pop 0.3s ease; }
  @media (max-width: 640px){ .entry{ padding-right:20px; } .entry-char{ display:none; } }

  footer{ text-align:center; margin-top: 40px; color: var(--text-dim); font-size:0.78rem; font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; }

  .notes-section{ margin-top: 34px; animation: fadeUp 0.6s ease 0.15s both; }
  .notes-header{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .notes-title{ font-family:'Cinzel', serif; font-weight:600; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--gold); letter-spacing: 0.05em; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; }
  .notes-title svg{ width:15px; height:15px; stroke: var(--gold); fill:none; stroke-width:1.8; }
  .notes-status{ font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.68rem; color: var(--text-dim); }
  .notes-status.saved{ color: #8fbf7a; }

  .notes-textarea{
    width:100%; min-height: 160px; resize: vertical;
    background: rgba(28,22,16,0.7); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--text);
    padding: 16px 18px; font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size:0.86rem; line-height: 1.6;
    outline:none; transition: border-color 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s;
  }
  .notes-textarea::placeholder{ color: var(--text-dim); }
  .notes-textarea:focus{ border-color: var(--gold); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(234,249,255,0.14), 0 0 16px rgba(95,208,221,0.2); }

  .map-row{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:14px; flex-wrap:nowrap; }
  .char-side{
    position: static; z-index: 0;
    height: 340px; max-height: 40vh; width: auto; flex-shrink: 0;
    opacity: 0.95;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.6));
    pointer-events: auto; cursor: pointer;
    animation: fadeUp 1.1s ease both;
    transition: transform 0.25s, filter 0.25s;
  }
  .char-side:hover{ transform: scale(1.04); filter: drop-shadow(0 14px 30px rgba(95,208,221,0.4)); }
  @media (max-width: 640px){ .char-side{ display:none; } }

  /* Modal */
  .overlay{
    position: fixed; inset:0; background: rgba(10,7,4,0.75); backdrop-filter: blur(3px);
    display:none; align-items:center; justify-content:center; z-index: 10; padding: 20px;
  }
  .overlay.open{ display:flex; animation: fadeUp 0.2s ease both; }
  .modal{
    background: #0b2436; border: 1px solid var(--bronze); padding: 28px; width: 100%; max-width: 420px;
    box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 30px rgba(95,208,221,0.15);
  }
  .modal h2{ font-family:'Cinzel', serif; color: var(--gold); font-size: 1.2rem; margin-bottom: 20px; letter-spacing:0.04em; }
  .field{ margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .field label{ display:block; font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size:0.72rem; color: var(--text-dim); margin-bottom:6px; letter-spacing:0.05em; }
  .field input, .field select{
    width:100%; background: #04121c; border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--text);
    padding: 10px 12px; font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size:0.88rem; outline:none;
    transition: border-color 0.2s;
  }
  .field input:focus, .field select:focus{ border-color: var(--gold); }
  .modal-actions{ display:flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: 22px; }
  .modal-actions .btn{ flex:1; }

  /* Krallık kayıtları modalı */
  .kingdom-modal{
    max-width: 560px; max-height: 82vh; overflow-y: auto; position: relative;
    border-width: 1px; border-style: solid;
  }
  .kingdom-modal.yellow{ --k: #d9a441; --kdim: rgba(217,164,65,0.35); border-color: rgba(217,164,65,0.9); box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 55px rgba(217,164,65,0.35); background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(217,164,65,0.32), #0b2436 60%); }
  .kingdom-modal.blue{ --k: #2dd4bf; --kdim: rgba(45,212,191,0.35); border-color: rgba(45,212,191,0.9); box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 55px rgba(45,212,191,0.35); background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(45,212,191,0.32), #0b2436 60%); }
  .kingdom-modal.red{ --k: #ef4444; --kdim: rgba(239,68,68,0.35); border-color: rgba(239,68,68,0.9); box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 55px rgba(239,68,68,0.35); background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(239,68,68,0.32), #0b2436 60%); }
  .kingdom-modal h2{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; }
  .kingdom-modal.yellow h2{ color: #d9a441; text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(217,164,65,0.5); }
  .kingdom-modal.blue h2{ color: #2dd4bf; text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(45,212,191,0.5); }
  .kingdom-modal.red h2{ color: #ef4444; text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(239,68,68,0.5); }
  .kingdom-modal .km-close{
    background:none; border:1px solid var(--iron); color: var(--text-dim); cursor:pointer;
    width: 30px; height: 30px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    font-size: 1rem; flex-shrink:0; transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s;
  }
  .kingdom-modal .km-close:hover{ color: var(--text); border-color: var(--bronze); }
  .kingdom-modal .km-sub{ font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size:0.72rem; color: var(--text-dim); margin: -12px 0 18px; }

  /* Sticky Note - Not Defteri */
  .note-overlay{
    position: fixed; inset:0; background: rgba(10,7,4,0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
    display:none; align-items:center; justify-content:center; z-index: 20; padding: 20px;
  }
  .note-overlay.open{ display:flex; animation: fadeUp 0.25s ease both; }

  @keyframes noteIn{
    from{ opacity:0; transform: rotate(-3deg) scale(0.9); }
    to{ opacity:1; transform: rotate(-1.2deg) scale(1); }
  }
  .note-paper{
    width: 100%; max-width: 420px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #e9dfb8 0%, #ddd0a0 100%);
    border-radius: 2px;
    padding: 26px 24px 22px;
    box-shadow: 0 25px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.55), 0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.15) inset;
    position: relative;
    transform: rotate(-1.2deg);
    animation: noteIn 0.3s ease both;
  }
  .note-paper::before{
    content:'';
    position:absolute; top:-14px; left:50%; transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(3deg);
    width: 46px; height: 26px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #c9432e, #8a3324);
    border-radius: 2px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    opacity: 0.85;
  }
  .note-header{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .note-title{
    font-family:'Cinzel', serif; font-weight:700; font-size: 1rem; color:#3a2f1a; letter-spacing:0.04em;
  }
  .note-close{
    background:none; border:none; cursor:pointer; color:#6b5a38; font-size: 1.1rem; line-height:1;
    padding: 4px 8px; transition: color 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
  }
  .note-close:hover{ color:#8a3324; transform: rotate(90deg); }

  .note-textarea{
    width:100%; min-height: 260px; resize: vertical;
    background: transparent; border:none; outline:none;
    color:#3a2f1a; font-family:'Sorts Mill Goudy', serif; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.9;
    background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, transparent 33px, rgba(90,70,30,0.25) 34px);
  }
  .note-textarea::placeholder{ color:#8a7548; font-style:italic; }

  .note-status{
    text-align:right; margin-top: 10px; font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.66rem;
    color:#7a6a45; letter-spacing:0.03em;
  }
  .note-status.saved{ color:#4d6b3a; }

  @media (max-width: 480px){
    h1{ font-size: 1.7rem; }
    .entry-meta{ flex-direction:column; gap:4px; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<video id="bgVideo" autoplay muted loop playsinline>
  <source src="https://res.cloudinary.com/dxbsrlgaf/video/upload/v1783908736/Blue_Cinematic_Action_Background_-_Epic_Movie_Style_Motion_Graphics_-_100_Free_Footage_No_Copyright_fgl098.mp4" type="video/mp4">
</video>
<div class="ice-overlay"></div>
<div class="wrap">
    <header>
      <div class="sigil" id="sigilBtn" title="Not defterini aç" style="cursor:pointer; pointer-events:auto;"></div>
      <h1>OtchiwaFARM</h1>
      <p class="subtitle">Metin2 hesap bilgilerinin saklandığı yer</p>
      <div class="divider"></div>
      <div class="status" id="status">yükleniyor...</div>
    </header>

    <div class="map-section">
      <div class="map-row">
        <img class="char-side left" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="">
        <div class="map-wrap">
        <img class="map-img" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Metin2 Dünya Haritası">
        <button class="map-flag flag-yellow" data-tag="SARI KRALLIK" title="Sarı Krallık kayıtları"></button>
        <button class="map-flag flag-blue" data-tag="MAVİ KRALLIK" title="Mavi Krallık kayıtları"></button>
        <button class="map-flag flag-red" data-tag="KIZIL KRALLIK" title="Kızıl Krallık kayıtları"></button>
      </div>
        <img class="char-side right" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="">
      </div>
      <div class="map-hint">bir bayrağa tıkla, o krallığın kayıtları listelensin</div>
    </div>

    <div class="toolbar" style="display:none;">
      <input class="search" id="searchInput" type="text" placeholder="karakter veya sunucu ara...">
      <button class="btn" id="addBtn">+ Yeni Kayıt</button>
      <button class="btn ghost" id="bulkAddBtn">Toplu Ekle</button>
    </div>

    <div class="kingdom-banner" id="kingdomBanner"></div>
    <div class="entries" id="entries" style="display:none;"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="note-overlay" id="noteOverlay">
    <div class="note-paper">
      <div class="note-header">
        <div class="note-title">✎ Not Defteri</div>
        <button class="note-close" id="noteCloseBtn">✕</button>
      </div>
      <textarea class="note-textarea" id="noteTextarea" placeholder="aklında kalsın diye buraya yaz..."></textarea>
      <div class="note-status" id="noteStatus"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="overlay" id="bulkOverlay">
    <div class="modal">
      <h2>Toplu Ekle</h2>
      <div class="field">
        <label>İsimleri virgülle ayırarak yapıştır (kullanıcı adı = şifre olacak)</label>
        <textarea id="bulkText" rows="6" placeholder="Ojooh , Ojooh1 , Ojooh2 , Ojooh3" style="width:100%; background:#04121c; border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--text); padding:10px 12px; font-family:'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size:0.85rem; outline:none; resize:vertical;"></textarea>
      </div>
      <div class="field">
        <label>Etiket</label>
        <select id="bulkTag">
          <option>SARI KRALLIK</option>
          <option>MAVİ KRALLIK</option>
          <option>KIZIL KRALLIK</option>
          <option>PVP SUNUCU</option>
          <option>PVE SUNUCU</option>
          <option>SEZONLUK</option>
          <option>FORUM</option>
          <option selected>DİĞER</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="modal-actions">
        <button class="btn ghost" id="bulkCancelBtn">Vazgeç</button>
        <button class="btn" id="bulkSaveBtn">Hepsini Ekle</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="overlay" id="kingdomOverlay">
    <div class="modal kingdom-modal" id="kingdomModal">
      <h2>
        <span id="kmTitle">Krallık Kayıtları</span>
        <button class="km-close" id="kmClose">✕</button>
      </h2>
      <div class="km-sub" id="kmSub"></div>
      <div class="entries" id="kmEntries"></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="overlay" id="overlay">
    <div class="modal">
      <h2 id="modalTitle">Yeni Kayıt</h2>
      <div class="field">
        <label>Başlık (ör. sunucu / hesap adı)</label>
        <input type="text" id="fName" placeholder="Ejderha Vadisi — Ana Hesap">
      </div>
      <div class="field">
        <label>Irk / Krallık</label>
        <select id="fTag">
          <option>SARI KRALLIK</option>
          <option>MAVİ KRALLIK</option>
          <option>KIZIL KRALLIK</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="field">
        <label>Sunucu adı</label>
        <input type="text" id="fServer" placeholder="ör. Ejderha Vadisi">
      </div>
      <div class="field">
        <label>Kullanıcı adı</label>
        <input type="text" id="fUser" placeholder="karakterX">
      </div>
      <div class="field">
        <label>Şifre</label>
        <input type="text" id="fPass" placeholder="şifre">
      </div>
      <div class="modal-actions">
        <button class="btn ghost" id="cancelBtn">Vazgeç</button>
        <button class="btn" id="saveBtn">Kaydet</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

<script>
  // --- Kor parçacıkları ---
  for(let i=0;i<42;i++){
    const e = document.createElement('div');
    e.className = 'ember';
    e.style.left = (Math.random()*100) + 'vw';
    e.style.setProperty('--dx', (Math.random()*80 - 40) + 'px');
    e.style.animationDuration = (9 + Math.random()*8) + 's';
    e.style.animationDelay = -(Math.random()*12) + 's';
    e.style.transform = `scale(${0.6 + Math.random()*1.2})`;
    document.body.appendChild(e);
  }

  // --- Depolama (bu tarayıcıya kalıcı olarak kaydeder) ---
  const STORAGE_KEY = 'kasa:entries';
  let entries = [];
  let editingId = null;

  const el = {
    entries: document.getElementById('entries'),
    status: document.getElementById('status'),
    search: document.getElementById('searchInput'),
    overlay: document.getElementById('overlay'),
    modalTitle: document.getElementById('modalTitle'),
    fName: document.getElementById('fName'),
    fTag: document.getElementById('fTag'),
    fServer: document.getElementById('fServer'),
    fUser: document.getElementById('fUser'),
    fPass: document.getElementById('fPass'),
  };

  function setStatus(msg, ok){
    el.status.textContent = msg;
    el.status.className = 'status' + (ok ? ' ok' : '');
  }

  function loadEntries(){
    setStatus('kasa açılıyor...');
    try{
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      entries = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
      setStatus('kayıtların bu tarayıcıda güvenle saklanıyor', true);
    }catch(err){
      entries = [];
      setStatus('bu tarayıcı kalıcı depolamayı desteklemiyor — kayıtlar sayfa kapanınca silinir');
    }
    render();
  }

  function persist(){
    try{
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(entries));
      setStatus('kaydedildi ✓', true);
    }catch(err){
      setStatus('kaydedilemedi: ' + err.message);
    }
  }

  function render(){
    const q = el.search.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const filtered = entries.filter(e =>
      e.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      e.user.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      e.tag.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      (e.server || '').toLowerCase().includes(q)
    );

    if(filtered.length === 0){
      if(entries.length === 0){
        el.entries.innerHTML = `
          <div class="empty">
            <div class="empty-text">Henüz kayıt yok. "+ Yeni Kayıt" ile ekleyebilirsin.</div>
          </div>`;
        return;
      }
      if(filtered.length === 0){
        el.entries.innerHTML = `<div class="empty"><div class="empty-text">Aramanla eşleşen kayıt yok.</div></div>`;
        return;
      }
      return;
    }

    el.entries.innerHTML = filtered.map((e, i) => `
      <div class="entry" data-id="${e.id}" style="animation-delay:${Math.min(i*0.06,0.4)}s">
        <div class="entry-name">${escapeHtml(e.name)}</div>
        <div class="entry-tag">${escapeHtml(e.tag)}${e.server ? ' · ' + escapeHtml(e.server) : ''}</div>
        <div class="entry-meta">
          <span>kullanıcı: <b>${escapeHtml(e.user)}</b></span>
          <span>şifre: <b class="pass" data-visible="false">••••••••</b></span>
        </div>
        <div class="entry-actions">
          <button class="toggle">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M1 12s4-7 11-7 11 7 11 7-4 7-11 7-11-7-11-7z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/></svg>
            <span class="lbl">göster</span>
          </button>
          <button class="copy">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="9" y="9" width="12" height="12" rx="1"/><path d="M5 15H4a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V4a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h10a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v1"/></svg>
            <span class="lbl">kopyala</span>
          </button>
          <button class="edit">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 20h9"/><path d="M16.5 3.5a2.1 2.1 0 0 1 3 3L7 19l-4 1 1-4 12.5-12.5z"/></svg>
            <span class="lbl">düzenle</span>
          </button>
          <button class="del">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><polyline points="3 6 5 6 21 6"/><path d="M19 6l-1 14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H8a2 2 0 0 1-2-2L5 6"/><path d="M10 11v6"/><path d="M14 11v6"/><path d="M9 6V4a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h4a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v2"/></svg>
            <span class="lbl">sil</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    `).join('');
  }

  function escapeHtml(s){
    return s.replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
  }

  el.entries.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
    const card = ev.target.closest('.entry');
    if(!card) return;
    const btn = ev.target.closest('button');
    if(!btn) return;
    const id = card.dataset.id;
    const entry = entries.find(x => x.id === id);
    if(!entry) return;

    btn.classList.add('pop');
    setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('pop'), 300);

    if(btn.classList.contains('toggle')){
      const passEl = card.querySelector('.pass');
      const lbl = btn.querySelector('.lbl');
      const visible = passEl.dataset.visible === 'true';
      passEl.textContent = visible ? '••••••••' : entry.pass;
      passEl.dataset.visible = (!visible).toString();
      lbl.textContent = visible ? 'göster' : 'gizle';
    }
    if(btn.classList.contains('copy')){
      const lbl = btn.querySelector('.lbl');
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(entry.pass).then(() => {
        btn.classList.add('copied');
        lbl.textContent = 'kopyalandı ✓';
        setTimeout(() => { btn.classList.remove('copied'); lbl.textContent = 'kopyala'; }, 1200);
      });
    }
    if(btn.classList.contains('edit')){
      openModal(entry);
    }
    if(btn.classList.contains('del')){
      if(confirm(`"${entry.name}" kaydını silmek istediğine emin misin?`)){
        entries = entries.filter(x => x.id !== id);
        persist();
        render();
      }
    }
  });

  function openModal(entry){
    editingId = entry ? entry.id : null;
    el.modalTitle.textContent = entry ? 'Kaydı Düzenle' : 'Yeni Kayıt';
    el.fName.value = entry ? entry.name : '';
    el.fTag.value = entry ? entry.tag : 'SARI KRALLIK';
    el.fServer.value = entry ? (entry.server || '') : '';
    el.fUser.value = entry ? entry.user : '';
    el.fPass.value = entry ? entry.pass : '';
    el.overlay.classList.add('open');
    el.fName.focus();
  }
  function closeModal(){
    el.overlay.classList.remove('open');
    editingId = null;
  }

  document.getElementById('addBtn').addEventListener('click', () => openModal(null));
  document.querySelectorAll('.char-side').forEach(img => {
    img.addEventListener('click', () => openModal(null));
  });
  document.getElementById('cancelBtn').addEventListener('click', closeModal);
  el.overlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if(e.target === el.overlay) closeModal(); });

  document.getElementById('saveBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const name = el.fName.value.trim();
    const server = el.fServer.value.trim();
    const user = el.fUser.value.trim();
    const pass = el.fPass.value;
    if(!name || !user || !pass){
      setStatus('lütfen tüm alanları doldur');
      return;
    }
    if(editingId){
      const e = entries.find(x => x.id === editingId);
      e.name = name; e.tag = el.fTag.value; e.server = server; e.user = user; e.pass = pass;
    }else{
      entries.push({ id: crypto.randomUUID(), name, tag: el.fTag.value, server, user, pass });
    }
    persist();
    render();
    closeModal();
  });

  el.search.addEventListener('input', () => {
    const kb = document.getElementById('kingdomBanner');
    if(kb) kb.classList.remove('show');
    render();
  });

  // --- Not Defteri (yapışkan not) ---
  const NOTE_KEY = 'kasa:note';
  const sigilBtn = document.getElementById('sigilBtn');
  const noteOverlay = document.getElementById('noteOverlay');
  const noteTextarea = document.getElementById('noteTextarea');
  const noteStatus = document.getElementById('noteStatus');
  const noteCloseBtn = document.getElementById('noteCloseBtn');
  let noteSaveTimer = null;

  function openNote(){
    try{
      noteTextarea.value = localStorage.getItem(NOTE_KEY) || '';
    }catch(err){ noteTextarea.value = ''; }
    noteOverlay.classList.add('open');
    noteStatus.textContent = '';
    noteStatus.className = 'note-status';
    setTimeout(() => noteTextarea.focus(), 50);
  }
  function closeNote(){
    noteOverlay.classList.remove('open');
  }

  sigilBtn.addEventListener('click', openNote);
  noteCloseBtn.addEventListener('click', closeNote);
  noteOverlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if(e.target === noteOverlay) closeNote(); });

  noteTextarea.addEventListener('input', () => {
    clearTimeout(noteSaveTimer);
    noteStatus.textContent = 'yazılıyor...';
    noteStatus.className = 'note-status';
    noteSaveTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      try{
        localStorage.setItem(NOTE_KEY, noteTextarea.value);
        noteStatus.textContent = 'kaydedildi ✓';
        noteStatus.className = 'note-status saved';
      }catch(err){
        noteStatus.textContent = 'kaydedilemedi';
      }
    }, 500);
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if(e.key === 'Escape' && noteOverlay.classList.contains('open')) closeNote();
  });

  // boş durum için karakter görsellerini mevcut etiketlerden al
  (function(){
    const leftImg = document.querySelector('.char-side.left');
    const rightImg = document.querySelector('.char-side.right');
    if(leftImg) window.__femaleB64 = leftImg.src.split('base64,')[1];
    if(rightImg) window.__maleB64 = rightImg.src.split('base64,')[1];
  })();

  // --- Toplu Ekle ---
  const bulkOverlay = document.getElementById('bulkOverlay');
  const bulkText = document.getElementById('bulkText');
  const bulkTag = document.getElementById('bulkTag');

  document.getElementById('bulkAddBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    bulkText.value = '';
    bulkOverlay.classList.add('open');
    setTimeout(() => bulkText.focus(), 50);
  });
  document.getElementById('bulkCancelBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    bulkOverlay.classList.remove('open');
  });
  bulkOverlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if(e.target === bulkOverlay) bulkOverlay.classList.remove('open'); });

  document.getElementById('bulkSaveBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const raw = bulkText.value.trim();
    if(!raw){ return; }
    const names = raw
      .split(/[,;\n]+/)
      .map(s => s.trim())
      .filter(s => s.length > 0 && s.toLowerCase() !== 'kontrol edeceksin');
    if(names.length === 0){ return; }
    names.forEach(name => {
      entries.push({ id: crypto.randomUUID(), name: name, tag: bulkTag.value, user: name, pass: name });
    });
    persist();
    render();
    bulkOverlay.classList.remove('open');
    setStatus(names.length + ' kayıt eklendi ✓', true);
  });

  // --- Harita bayrakları: renkli modal aç ---
  const kingdomOverlay = document.getElementById('kingdomOverlay');
  const kingdomModal = document.getElementById('kingdomModal');
  const kmTitle = document.getElementById('kmTitle');
  const kmSub = document.getElementById('kmSub');
  const kmEntries = document.getElementById('kmEntries');

  const kingdomMeta = {
    'SARI KRALLIK': { cls: 'yellow', title: 'Sarı Krallık Kayıtları' },
    'MAVİ KRALLIK': { cls: 'blue',   title: 'Mavi Krallık Kayıtları' },
    'KIZIL KRALLIK': { cls: 'red',   title: 'Kızıl Krallık Kayıtları' }
  };

  function renderKingdomEntries(tag){
    const list = entries.filter(e => e.tag === tag);
    if(list.length === 0){
      kmEntries.innerHTML = `<div class="empty"><div class="empty-text">Bu krallıkta henüz kayıt yok.</div></div>`;
      return;
    }
    kmEntries.innerHTML = list.map((e, i) => `
      <div class="entry" data-id="${e.id}" style="animation-delay:${Math.min(i*0.06,0.4)}s">
        <span class="entry-corner tl"></span>
        <span class="entry-corner bl"></span>
        ${i % 2 === 0 ? (window.__femaleB64 ? `<img class="entry-char" src="data:image/png;base64,${window.__femaleB64}" alt="">` : '') : (window.__maleB64 ? `<img class="entry-char" src="data:image/png;base64,${window.__maleB64}" alt="">` : '')}
        <div class="entry-tag">${escapeHtml(e.tag)}</div>
        <div class="entry-name">${escapeHtml(e.name)}</div>
        ${e.server ? `<div class="entry-meta"><span>sunucu: <b>${escapeHtml(e.server)}</b></span></div>` : ''}
        <div class="entry-toprow">
          <div class="entry-creds">
            <div class="entry-chip"><span class="ic">&#9679;</span><div class="txt"><span class="lbl">Kullanıcı</span><span class="val">${escapeHtml(e.user)}</span></div></div>
            <div class="entry-chip"><span class="ic">&#128274;</span><div class="txt"><span class="lbl">Şifre</span><span class="val dots pass" data-visible="false">••••••••</span></div></div>
          </div>
          <button class="entry-gear" title="işlemler">&#9881;</button>
        </div>
        <div class="entry-actions">
          <button class="toggle">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M1 12s4-7 11-7 11 7 11 7-4 7-11 7-11-7-11-7z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/></svg>
            <span class="lbl">göster</span>
          </button>
          <button class="copy">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="9" y="9" width="12" height="12" rx="1"/><path d="M5 15H4a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V4a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h10a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v1"/></svg>
            <span class="lbl">kopyala</span>
          </button>
          <button class="edit">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 20h9"/><path d="M16.5 3.5a2.1 2.1 0 0 1 3 3L7 19l-4 1 1-4 12.5-12.5z"/></svg>
            <span class="lbl">düzenle</span>
          </button>
          <button class="del">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><polyline points="3 6 5 6 21 6"/><path d="M19 6l-1 14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H8a2 2 0 0 1-2-2L5 6"/><path d="M10 11v6"/><path d="M14 11v6"/><path d="M9 6V4a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h4a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v2"/></svg>
            <span class="lbl">sil</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    `).join('');
  }

  kmEntries.addEventListener('click', (ev) => {
    const card = ev.target.closest('.entry');
    if(!card) return;
    const btn = ev.target.closest('button');
    if(!btn) return;
    const id = card.dataset.id;
    const entry = entries.find(x => x.id === id);
    if(!entry) return;

    if(btn.classList.contains('entry-gear')){
      const nowOpen = btn.classList.toggle('active');
      card.querySelector('.entry-actions').classList.toggle('open');
      if(nowOpen){
        const rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
        const cardRect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
        const cx = rect.left - cardRect.left + rect.width / 2;
        const cy = rect.top - cardRect.top + rect.height / 2;
        for(let s = 0; s < 6; s++){
          const spark = document.createElement('span');
          spark.className = 'entry-spark';
          const ang = (Math.PI * 2 / 6) * s;
          const dist = 22 + Math.random() * 10;
          spark.style.left = cx + 'px';
          spark.style.top = cy + 'px';
          spark.style.setProperty('--sx', (Math.cos(ang) * dist).toFixed(1) + 'px');
          spark.style.setProperty('--sy', (Math.sin(ang) * dist).toFixed(1) + 'px');
          spark.style.animationDelay = (s * 0.02) + 's';
          card.appendChild(spark);
          setTimeout(() => spark.remove(), 800);
        }
      }
      return;
    }

    if(btn.classList.contains('toggle')){
      const passEl = card.querySelector('.pass');
      const lbl = btn.querySelector('.lbl');
      const visible = passEl.dataset.visible === 'true';
      passEl.textContent = visible ? '••••••••' : entry.pass;
      passEl.dataset.visible = (!visible).toString();
      lbl.textContent = visible ? 'göster' : 'gizle';
    }
    if(btn.classList.contains('copy')){
      const lbl = btn.querySelector('.lbl');
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(entry.pass).then(() => {
        btn.classList.add('copied');
        lbl.textContent = 'kopyalandı ✓';
        setTimeout(() => { btn.classList.remove('copied'); lbl.textContent = 'kopyala'; }, 1200);
      });
    }
    if(btn.classList.contains('edit')){
      kingdomOverlay.classList.remove('open');
      openModal(entry);
    }
    if(btn.classList.contains('del')){
      if(confirm(`"${entry.name}" kaydını silmek istediğine emin misin?`)){
        entries = entries.filter(x => x.id !== id);
        persist();
        render();
        renderKingdomEntries(entry.tag);
      }
    }
  });

  function openKingdomModal(tag){
    const meta = kingdomMeta[tag];
    if(!meta) return;
    kingdomModal.className = 'modal kingdom-modal ' + meta.cls;
    kmTitle.textContent = meta.title;
    kmSub.textContent = 'bu ırka ait kayıtlı hesap/şifreler';
    renderKingdomEntries(tag);
    kingdomOverlay.classList.add('open');
  }

  document.getElementById('kmClose').addEventListener('click', () => {
    kingdomOverlay.classList.remove('open');
  });
  kingdomOverlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if(e.target === kingdomOverlay) kingdomOverlay.classList.remove('open'); });

  document.querySelectorAll('.map-flag').forEach(flag => {
    flag.addEventListener('click', () => {
      openKingdomModal(flag.dataset.tag);
    });
  });

  const gotoEntriesLink = document.getElementById('gotoEntries');
  if(gotoEntriesLink){
    gotoEntriesLink.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      document.getElementById('entries').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    });
  }

  loadEntries();
</script>
</body>
</html>
